list.title: Sentencia libri De sensu et sensato

CRITICAL_SPLIT: kind=independent vs kind=commentary. EA-RELFORM-01 §4: R3 (arbitrary procedural agreement) is INADMISSIBLE on commentary works, because Albert and Thomas both comment on Aristotle and any Aristotelian reflex appears in both BY CONSTRUCTION. Independent works are the clean test.
why_seated: The externally-secured S-class control M36a demanded and no Greek figure could supply. Thomas Aquinas is attested by canonization proceedings, university registers, papal bulls and Dominican chapter records — evidence with no relation to textual style, doctrinal similarity, or any succession tradition under test. He cannot be inside a Plato-Aristotle configuration under any extension of the hypothesis.
verified_loci: Summa Theologiae — 'respondeo dicendum' 2,669; 'videtur quod' 4,227 (the article formulae)

⚠ CORRECTION: an initial prefix table mislabelled EVERY commentary. 'cme' was declared In Metaphysicam and is Sentencia super Meteora; 'cmp' is the Metaphysics; 'ccm' is De caelo; 'ctc' is the Ethics; 'cps' is IN PSALMOS, not De sensu; 'cdn' is Dionysius; 'cio' is Job. Caught by a failed locus probe ('metaphysic' returning 0 in the file labelled In Metaphysicam) and rebuilt from each text's own header.
kind_note: THREE kinds, not two. 'aristotle-commentary' carries the shared-source contamination of EA-RELFORM-01 §4 (R3 inadmissible). 'other-commentary' (Scripture, Dionysius, De causis) does NOT — it is exposition, but not on the text whose reflex is being counted. 'independent' is the clean test.
